verdict.rationale: GitHub documents applying review feedback in a couple of clicks, though only for Copilot code review's suggested changes (github-docs-25). It also offers a cloud-based development environment (github-docs-3) and a cloud agent that commits changes to a branch without leaving GitHub.com (github-docs-26, github-docs-73). However, the evidence never explicitly shows a developer hand-editing files and committing them in the browser in response to human review comments. Missing for 10: explicit docs for an in-browser file editor with commit flow, committing human reviewers' suggested changes from the PR page, confirmation that the cloud environment runs in the browser, independent/hands-on corroboration.
